pairs.subject: visual-script-to-code-transpilation
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/blueprint/GeneratedFilesPanel.tsx:35 The panel calls a run 'declared-and-defined' just because the agent reported a file list, even when the build failed, and it ranks that rung below 'compiles'; the standard ranks it above, and nothing here or in CodegenReport reads the emitted .h/.cpp back to check that both sides agree, so the panel claims a rung it never proved.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/blueprint/GeneratedFilesPanel.tsx:35 There is no step that reads the output back and asserts parity (procedure step 3). CodegenReport only carries filesWritten/buildOk/seedRan, yet a failed build is labelled 'declared-and-defined'. On the plus side, the class name and the file stem come from one sanitiser (codegen.ts:57), so the one-source half of the identifier rule is met.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/blueprint/codegen.ts:107 An empty or unmappable attribute falls back to an invented name and emits UARPGAttributeSet::GetUnknownAttribute(), which does not exist. The shared renderModifierInfo's null→TODO refusal is bypassed, and the preview disagrees with the preflight's 'becomes // TODO: unknown attribute' contract. The DURATION_POLICY Record at line 62 is a total enum map, but the attribute entry is the fallback the technique forbids. Also, sanitizeIdentifier (line 43) strips characters without a warning.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/blueprint/CodePreview.tsx:43 The only comparison the context offers is a line-oriented LCS text diff between two preview renderings. Nothing compares the retained spec, which is still the authority, with the generated C++ files in the UE project, so drift after an agent writes or someone hand-edits those files cannot be detected.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/blueprint/CodePreview.tsx:107 The emitted C++ (UPROPERTY(BlueprintReadOnly…), DurationPolicy, FGameplayModifierInfo) is shown as raw highlighted HTML with no inline term layer. The repo already has a single-sourced glossary with a BlueprintReadOnly entry (src/lib/blueprint-jargon.ts via JargonTerm/TermChip), but grep finds no use of it under sub_ability/. Partly met: the preflight messages are designer-worded, structured findings.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/blueprint/types.ts:27 The wiring graph's node kinds are attributes, effects and tag rules only. There are no event nodes to resolve against an owner type. The PreAttributeChange/PostGameplayEffectExecute overrides, which do carry `override`, live in src/lib/gas-codegen.ts, outside this context.

pairs.registryProposal: The golden path notes that spec-to-code generation (no source graph) shares the ladder but has 'no source graph to diff against'. This context shows a middle case the corpus does not address: the GUI spec is retained and authoritative, while the code is written by an LLM agent into the engine tree. A spec-to-on-disk-code drift check belongs in the structural-round-trip-diff technique, which currently assumes a graph export.
